name: Wojo Live Rosin | Luchini
description:
Lineage : Lemon Peel x Don Mega

Effects: Chill and Heal

Flavor Profile: Funky

Bred By: SOLFIRE GARDENS

This magical plant has checked all the boxes from the get-go.

It produces a generous yield of stunning hash with unique terps.

Luchini tastes like a lemon peel soaked in gas and drizzled with honey.

It's refreshing, appealing, and exotic.
